title: Build the Hardened User Store
prompt: Register/Validate with per-user salted PBKDF2, duplicate-register rejection, data-only lookup, and confined file resolution.

tests.name: register then validate, right and wrong
stored hash is the PBKDF2 reference, salted per user
tests.hint: Per-user salt makes identical passwords hash differently.

tests.name: duplicate registration throws
lookup treats input as data
tests.hint: The store has no query text to inject into.

tests.name: file gateway confines traversal
tests.hint: Resolve, then confine — same barrier as the practice set.
